correctness.rationale: The sixth Schatten trace is reconstructed from the 3x3 weighted cycle: C-Ds2+(3C+6t^3u^3 cos(6theta))s3. Nonnegative winding coefficient fixes the phase supremum at theta=0. Schur gives the sharp bound s2-9s3/4<=1/4 and its exact equality cases; s2<=1/3 completes the two-branch optimization. The ratio E/D=(1-q)^2/(1-2q) increases to infinity and crosses 9/4 at the stated q*, with t=1/2 handled separately. Exact rational matrix arithmetic verifies 98 sample identities; 8,575 simplex sample checks supplement, but do not replace, the proof. All boundary and zero-weight cases are included.

value.rationale: This naturally normalized complete finite-dimensional operator invariant uses the first winding-sensitive even Schatten moment of a directed triangle. It detects a discontinuous and exact support transition (uniform full cycle to equal-weight broken path), coexistence at an algebraic threshold, and an enlarged boundary minimizer family at the symmetric parameter. Neither fourth-order paths nor dimension-uniform upper inequalities determine this phenomenon. The claim is not a mere numerical enumeration or arbitrary parameter slice.
